prompt: Origin: Cypher CAD render (transparent PNG, 2048x2048) from the Designs page of the Seattle Solvers Google Site (sites.google.com/view/seattlesolvers/resources/cad-designs), downloaded 2026-09-27; cropped to the artwork's alpha bounds with a 4% margin (1989x2019); resized to 1379x1400; re-encoded 2026-09-27 from the source PNG as webp q75 with lossy alpha (alpha_q 80). Shown on the light drawing plate on /resources/designs, and in the /resources hub strip on high-density screens.
